Thai massage, yoga, yoga therapy and chronic pain management. I specialize in soft tissue chronic pain management and helping people overcome issues that doctors and physical therapists sometimes overlook. I help frequently with carpal tunnel syndrome, thoracic outlet syndrome, sciatica, chronic menstrual pain and the common upper back and neck pain in addition to low back pain.

Work on yourself, work on others & information to help with pain relief. Yoga therapy and pain science informed manual therapy videos. I'm located in Austin, Texas but I can work with you where you are via zoom. Work on yourself and help others. I've dedicated half of my life to coming up with common sense solutions to chronic pain issues after being hit by a drunk driver and suffering in pain myself.

If you need help please contact me.
